Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Kitchen Island Butcher Block Buffet Cart with Wheels, Natural Wood Finish
This rustic kitchen cart features a black metal frame with crossed supports for a bit of country class. The black hardware stands out against a beautiful natural wood finish on the shelves and drawers. Wood Features 2 drawers and 3 shelves for maximum storage space 42.5" H x 34" W x 17" D Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
